title: 🎮 A Game Made Without AI Tops Epic's AI Competition! And the Secret Is "Human Slop"!
body: 🎮 A Game Made Without AI Tops Epic's AI Competition! And the Secret Is "Human Slop"!

In a striking irony, a game made entirely without any artificial intelligence is leading the public vote in Epic Games' competition, which was originally meant for games built with AI, even though the competition encourages developers to use AI tools.

The game is called "LSD: FIH" — a shooter in which the player takes the role of a fish carrying a sniper rifle, shooting balls as fast as possible to keep a combo streak going — and its developer himself described it as "human slop," meaning a purely human work with no machine help at all.
The competition lasted 4 days and ended on November 15, with prizes of $50,000, and its rules encourage "vibe coding" using AI tools, but the FAQ confirmed that using AI is not a requirement to win.

Public voting continues until January 29, 2027, while observers see the human-made game's lead as possibly a reaction to statements by Epic CEO Tim Sweeney in favor of AI, including his description of Steam's AI-use disclosure policy as "abhorrent."
Simply put: in an AI competition, a purely human work is winning so far — are people voting for the game itself, or against AI?
Would you prefer a game made entirely by human hands, or does it not matter to you how it was made as long as it is fun?
